raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-GTM-SmartPublicFinances",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Cyberattacks and ransomware targeting critical government systems could cause prolonged operational outages and loss of sensitive financial data.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish an Information Security Management System (ISMS), deploy a CSIRT and Security Operations Center, and upgrade resilience infrastructure.",
      "evidence": "The digital portals of the State Contracting and Acquisitions Information System known as Guatecompras and SICOIN stopped working, attributed to a cyber-attack."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "A decline in remittance inflows could diminish VAT tax revenue, constraining government spending capacity and fiscal sustainability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen medium-term fiscal planning (MTEF) instruments and enhance revenue management integration to manage revenue volatility.",
      "evidence": "any decline in these inflows could reduce Value-Added Tax (VAT) collections, which currently generate 47.8 percent of the government’s net income"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Extreme weather events and natural disasters could disrupt government ICT systems and physical infrastructure, threatening administrative continuity.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) following ISO 22301 and implement cloud adoption strategies and resilient hardware.",
      "evidence": "Guatemala ranks ninth globally for exposure to climate change impacts, driven by deforestation, land degradation, and pressure on water resources."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Fragmentation and obsolescence of existing PFM systems create data silos and hinder automated transactional execution across entities.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define an Integrated PFM Conceptual Model and deploy a unified enterprise architecture with a subnational and central interoperability platform.",
      "evidence": "fragmentation between central and decentralized entities impedes efficiency, including Treasury Single Account management and information consolidation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "High turnover and lack of career development structures for public sector data and ICT specialists could impair ongoing system operationalization.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish structured career paths, institutionalize data analytics units, and deliver continuous, permanent training programs in PFM and analytics.",
      "evidence": "Governments also struggle to build and retain analytical capacity due to the lack of structured career paths for data professionals, insufficient training opportunities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Institutional instability and loss of reform leadership within implementing bodies could cause project implementation delays and loss of momentum.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Anchor project implementation within the Technical Budget Directorate (DTP) and establish clear interinstitutional governance committees.",
      "evidence": "A common reason for the failure of PFM reforms in previous projects in Guatemala is the lack of adequate preparation and institutional stability"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Weak public procurement competitiveness and contract monitoring controls may result in execution delays and project cost overruns.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Modernize the National Procurement and Contracting System and integrate transactional procurement tracking with budget execution controls.",
      "evidence": "weaknesses impact the effectiveness of investment management, including... weak procurement competitiveness, lack of lifecycle project monitoring, and insufficient data on total costs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Low adoption rate of gender budget tagging (CPEG) by municipal governments could restrict comprehensive monitoring of social equity spending.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deploy upgraded municipal financial management systems and conduct targeted technical assistance and training in coordination with SEPREM.",
      "evidence": "only 112 municipalities out of 340 linked their budget to the CPEG"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "High informal economy levels and low public spending volume constrain structural domestic revenue mobilization and state capacity.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enhance revenue management systems, streamline property tax tools, and optimize public spending productivity across core public service sectors.",
      "evidence": "the informal economy accounted for 23.3 percent of GDP, with 71.1 percent of the workforce employed in informal sectors."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Weak prioritization and poor alignment between public investment planning and medium-term expenditure limits lead to project discontinuities and maintenance deficits.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Redesign SEGEPLAN's planning and investment evaluation methodologies and establish a multi-year public investment plan linked to the MTEF.",
      "evidence": "inadequate prioritization due to poor alignment with financial constraints, frequent project discontinuities, underfunded maintenance"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Cyberattacks and ransomware targeting critical government systems could cause prolonged operational outages and loss of sensitive financial data.
risks.mitigation: Establish an Information Security Management System (ISMS), deploy a CSIRT and Security Operations Center, and upgrade resilience infrastructure.
risks.evidence: The digital portals of the State Contracting and Acquisitions Information System known as Guatecompras and SICOIN stopped working, attributed to a cyber-attack.

risks.description: A decline in remittance inflows could diminish VAT tax revenue, constraining government spending capacity and fiscal sustainability.
risks.mitigation: Strengthen medium-term fiscal planning (MTEF) instruments and enhance revenue management integration to manage revenue volatility.
risks.evidence: any decline in these inflows could reduce Value-Added Tax (VAT) collections, which currently generate 47.8 percent of the government’s net income

risks.description: Extreme weather events and natural disasters could disrupt government ICT systems and physical infrastructure, threatening administrative continuity.
risks.mitigation: Develop a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) following ISO 22301 and implement cloud adoption strategies and resilient hardware.
risks.evidence: Guatemala ranks ninth globally for exposure to climate change impacts, driven by deforestation, land degradation, and pressure on water resources.

risks.description: Fragmentation and obsolescence of existing PFM systems create data silos and hinder automated transactional execution across entities.
risks.mitigation: Define an Integrated PFM Conceptual Model and deploy a unified enterprise architecture with a subnational and central interoperability platform.
risks.evidence: fragmentation between central and decentralized entities impedes efficiency, including Treasury Single Account management and information consolidation.

risks.description: High turnover and lack of career development structures for public sector data and ICT specialists could impair ongoing system operationalization.
risks.mitigation: Establish structured career paths, institutionalize data analytics units, and deliver continuous, permanent training programs in PFM and analytics.
risks.evidence: Governments also struggle to build and retain analytical capacity due to the lack of structured career paths for data professionals, insufficient training opportunities

risks.description: Institutional instability and loss of reform leadership within implementing bodies could cause project implementation delays and loss of momentum.
risks.mitigation: Anchor project implementation within the Technical Budget Directorate (DTP) and establish clear interinstitutional governance committees.
risks.evidence: A common reason for the failure of PFM reforms in previous projects in Guatemala is the lack of adequate preparation and institutional stability

risks.description: Weak public procurement competitiveness and contract monitoring controls may result in execution delays and project cost overruns.
risks.mitigation: Modernize the National Procurement and Contracting System and integrate transactional procurement tracking with budget execution controls.
risks.evidence: weaknesses impact the effectiveness of investment management, including... weak procurement competitiveness, lack of lifecycle project monitoring, and insufficient data on total costs

risks.description: Low adoption rate of gender budget tagging (CPEG) by municipal governments could restrict comprehensive monitoring of social equity spending.
risks.mitigation: Deploy upgraded municipal financial management systems and conduct targeted technical assistance and training in coordination with SEPREM.
risks.evidence: only 112 municipalities out of 340 linked their budget to the CPEG

risks.description: High informal economy levels and low public spending volume constrain structural domestic revenue mobilization and state capacity.
risks.mitigation: Enhance revenue management systems, streamline property tax tools, and optimize public spending productivity across core public service sectors.
risks.evidence: the informal economy accounted for 23.3 percent of GDP, with 71.1 percent of the workforce employed in informal sectors.

risks.description: Weak prioritization and poor alignment between public investment planning and medium-term expenditure limits lead to project discontinuities and maintenance deficits.
risks.mitigation: Redesign SEGEPLAN's planning and investment evaluation methodologies and establish a multi-year public investment plan linked to the MTEF.
risks.evidence: inadequate prioritization due to poor alignment with financial constraints, frequent project discontinuities, underfunded maintenance
